name: Kibberia Fresh Foods
old_description: Commercial kitchen offering over 350 products from around the world!
about:
Kibberia Foods operates commercial kitchens in Danbury, Connecticut, and Lafayette, Louisiana. The company traces its roots to a restaurant opened in Danbury by founder Carole Iskandar and her husband Sam more than ten years ago, and it remains family owned and operated. In 2021, the business expanded to Lafayette to serve retailers in the Southeast.

The facilities produce more than 350 recipes and maintain an established line of over 250 SKUs, ranging from individual portions to food-service packaging. All ingredients are received and processed on the same day, and products are made fresh to order. The kitchens are certified under SQF, HACCP, and FSMA standards, with USDA inspection on site.

Kibberia Foods supplies large retailers and supermarkets, primarily in the Northeast and Southeast regions. Its customer base includes supermarket chains that carry the company's all-natural, prepared foods under their own brands or the Kibberia label.

The company emphasizes a boutique approach to recipe development, offering rapid turnaround from concept to mass production in as little as one week. It also highlights flexibility in pricing, packaging, and seasonal adjustments, and donates surplus food to local charities.
